findings.finding: Correctly adds Zvknha as an implied extension of Zvknhb, matching the normative requirement [#norm:Zvknhb_impZvknha] at zvk.adoc:483: 'Zvknhb implies Zvknha'. Zvknha's Zve32x dependency is transitively satisfied via Zvknhb→Zve64x→Zve32x. No circular dependency, no missing CSR/migration/TCG concerns.
